ETEL.note: H1-26: revenue +17%, net profit +47%, tariff increases approved, 5G rollout. Caution: profit swings with FX; price is above the analyst targets found.

SWDY.note: H1-26: revenue +32%, ~$6.5bn project backlog. Caution: net profit grew only 14% and margin is narrowing; price is above the analyst targets found.

TMGH.note: 2Q-26: net profit +21% to EGP 4.5bn, revenue +14%; H1 net +23%, strong contracted sales. Caution: property demand is sensitive to rates, inflation and cash collection.

EGAL.note: FY25/26: net profit +52% to EGP 15.5bn, revenue +23%. Caution: cyclical, depends on aluminium prices and energy costs.

MFPC.note: H1-26: net profit +70% to EGP 9.9bn, revenue +52%, ~80% exports, stable gas supply. Caution: gas supply and urea price swings.

ABUK.note: H1-26: net profit EGP 10.0bn on EGP 23.5bn revenue, plants at full capacity, capacity upgrade done. Caution: depends on gas supply and urea prices.

ORAS.note: H1-26: revenue +52%, net profit +90%, backlog $10.9bn (+14%), new awards +42%, data-center work. Caution: Q2 operating cash outflow; thin construction margins.

ALCN.note: H1-26: net profit +18% to EGP 3.8bn but revenue only +3%; AD Ports tender offer is a possible catalyst. Caution: profit growth is not coming from revenue growth.

EFIH.note: H1-26: net profit +64% to EGP 1.8bn on revenue +29% (EGP 4.2bn); FY25 net profit EGP 2.45bn (+34%). Caution: relies on government-linked payment business, and the price already reflects strong growth (roughly 28x trailing profit by my calculation).

ADIB.note: H1-26: net profit +21% to EGP 7.5bn, total income +25% to EGP 29.1bn; Q1 profit +20.5%. Caution: EPS fell to 4.98 from 7.43 (probably more shares after a capital increase, worth checking); bank earnings depend on rates and inflation.

FWRY.note: H1-26: revenue +39% to EGP 5.2bn, net profit +29% to EGP 1.6bn (31% margin), transaction value +52%, growth accelerated in Q2, neobanking and a medical platform planned for 2027. Caution: profit is growing slower than revenue; competition in payments.

ORHD.note: Q1-26: net profit -16% to EGP 1.72bn on flat revenue; FY25 profit +79% to EGP 5.5bn with a large deferred-revenue backlog. Caution: reports for H1-26 conflicted, so I could not confirm the consolidated result; hospitality is exposed to regional tension.

EFID.note: H1-26: revenue +33% to EGP 12.3bn, net profit +63% to EGP 1.5bn, margin up to 12.2%, exports +52%. Caution: growth slowed in Q2 (profit +31% vs +102% in Q1); food input costs and FX.

PHDC.note: H1-26: revenue +25% to EGP 19.5bn and record EGP 284bn backlog, EGP 75bn of Ras El-Hekma sales in two weeks. Caution: net profit fell 7% to EGP 2.3bn and EBITDA margin dropped to 21% from 29%; Q1 drop was partly a one-off land sale last year.
